artifacts.purpose: Select isolated configured products.
artifacts.schema: CONFIG.md; scripts/init_config.py registry schema_version 1.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: scripts/verify_config.py product selection.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore with the matching private product policies.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while any configured product is in use or needs restoration.

artifacts.purpose: Bind one product policy to its documentation root.
artifacts.schema: CONFIG.md; skills/auto-support/scripts/policy.py.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Policy loading and draft readiness checks.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the private configuration and update its machine path deliberately.

retention_rule.rule: Keep each current product profile with its policy; remove retired profiles after all delivery and restore dependencies end.

artifacts.purpose: Authoritative allow, deny, confidence and integration configuration.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/policy.py: validate_policy and load_policy.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Draft CLI, read hook and separately provisioned delivery integration.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected version from private history.

retention_rule.rule: Keep the effective policy and references required by an active product or its recovery.

artifacts.purpose: Deduplication fingerprints with last_sent and severity.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _load_state and _save_state.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The next escalation admission and delivery reconciliation.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the last confirmed state; do not clear it to retry an uncertain delivery.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while dispatch or reconciliation can refer to the state. Retire only after dispatch stops and outstanding delivery outcomes are resolved.

artifacts.purpose: Exclusive escalation writer and interrupted dispatch marker.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _state_lock.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Concurrent dispatch protection and operator reconciliation.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Resolve the prior delivery outcome before removing a stale lock.

retention_rule.rule: Keep until its writer has stopped and delivery/commit status is known.

artifacts.purpose: Atomic replacement staging for escalation state.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _save_state.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The active state commit.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rebuild from reconciled state after confirming the previous commit boundary.

retention_rule.rule: Remove after normal replacement or a reviewed inactive recovery; never remove an active writer's file.

artifacts.purpose: Credentials explicitly provisioned for a delivery integration.
artifacts.schema: CONFIG.md secret references; the selected provider credential format.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The separately configured delivery integration.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore through the approved private credential backup or reauthorize.

retention_rule.rule: Keep current credentials while their integration or recovery requires them; retire replaced credentials after rotation is confirmed.

artifacts.purpose: Machine-bound credentials for an explicitly configured integration.
artifacts.schema: Windows DPAPI credential encoding; CONFIG.md.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The configured local credential resolver.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore on the bound machine or reauthorize on a new machine.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only credentials needed by an active integration or its approved recovery.

artifacts.purpose: Private asset inventory used to review the effective deny policy.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/reference/config-schema.md.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Policy review for the matching product.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore its selected private version.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only an actually maintained inventory used to review a current product; empty templates are not runtime evidence.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recreate the copy from the current source LICENSE.

artifacts.purpose: Delivery fingerprints and cooldown state when the runtime resolver selects the companion root.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/runtime_data.py: state_path; skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _load_state and _save_state.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Subsequent escalation admission and delivery reconciliation.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the last confirmed private state and reconcile uncertain delivery before retrying.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while dispatch, cooldown or unresolved delivery outcomes depend on it. The root path applies when the selected companion has no data directory.

artifacts.purpose: Exclusive dispatch and interrupted-delivery marker beside root escalation state.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _state_lock.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Concurrent dispatch protection and operator reconciliation.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Resolve the prior delivery outcome before clearing an inactive lock.

retention_rule.rule: Keep until the writer has stopped and the delivery and state-commit outcomes are known.

artifacts.purpose: Atomic replacement staging beside root escalation state.
artifacts.schema: skills/auto-support/scripts/escalate.py: _save_state.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: The active escalation state commit.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Rebuild from reconciled state after confirming the previous replacement boundary.

retention_rule.rule: Remove only after normal replacement or a reviewed inactive recovery; never remove an active writer's staging file.

artifacts.purpose: Selected incident containment, review and recovery checklist.
artifacts.schema: Markdown recovery procedure; current source security, escalation and red-team references govern implementation checks.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Operator incident review and recovery handoff.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the selected private version until a reviewed replacement covers its recovery duties.

retention_rule.rule: Keep this exact procedure until a reviewed replacement exists and unresolved incident and delivery outcomes are closed. References to retired installation or rotation helpers do not establish that those helpers are valid.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded separate escalation configuration for a product.
artifacts.schema: Legacy JSON escalation object; CONFIG.md and the current product policy define the replacement.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Migration review against matching policy.json and separately configured dispatcher arguments; the shipped dispatcher does not load policy escalation settings.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore effective escalation and approval settings from the matching private policy version.

retention_rule.rule: Retire after every setting is preserved in the matching policy and all external consumers have been checked. Current source has no reader for this separate file.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded deployment settings composer.
artifacts.schema: Legacy Python CLI; current policy root resolution and settings template are authoritative.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of earlier deployment steps; current source initialization and doctor do not use this helper.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recover historical deployment evidence from private history; prepare a separately reviewed integration from current source requirements.

retention_rule.rule: This helper does not use the current product-root resolver and replaces permission lists. Retire only after external invocation and recovery references are checked.

artifacts.purpose: Earlier local credential capture helper for the superseded deployment procedure.
artifacts.schema: Legacy PowerShell DPAPI capture CLI; credential provisioning belongs to the selected integration.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of old rotation and restoration steps; current source has no credential capture consumer.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Use the approved private credential backup or reauthorize through a reviewed integration.

retention_rule.rule: Retire the helper after all external capture and recovery dependencies are checked. This classification does not retire credential files or their backups.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded pointer and credential-presence inspection helper.
artifacts.schema: Legacy shell CLI; scripts/verify_config.py owns current draft configuration checks.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of old deployment checks; current configuration uses the source doctor.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Run the current source doctor for draft configuration and separately validate the selected delivery integration.

retention_rule.rule: Pointer and credential presence do not establish current readiness. Retire after external invocation and recovery references are checked.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded machine restoration steps for the earlier deployment helpers.
artifacts.schema: Legacy Markdown procedure; CONFIG.md defines current product-root setup and draft checks.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of historical restoration assumptions; current restoration uses product.json and the source doctor.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore current private policies and credentials, then prepare reviewed machine setup from current source documentation.

retention_rule.rule: The procedure depends on retired capture and apply helpers and bypasses current product-root setup. Retire after remaining recovery references have a reviewed replacement.

artifacts.purpose: Superseded credential rotation steps for the earlier deployment helpers.
artifacts.schema: Legacy Markdown procedure; the selected credential integration owns rotation and receipt checks.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of the prior rotation chain and its incident-recovery references.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Use a reviewed rotation procedure for the current credential integration and confirm replacement credentials before retirement.

retention_rule.rule: The procedure depends on retired capture, apply and verify helpers. Keep pending removal until incident and external recovery references are replaced and rotation outcomes are resolved.

artifacts.purpose: Historical notes about the earlier companion deployment setup.
artifacts.schema: Legacy Markdown change notes; current CONFIG.md and DATA.md define supported setup and retention.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of superseded helper and exclusion assumptions.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recover historical setup notes from private history when a review requires them.

retention_rule.rule: These notes describe retired helpers and obsolete runtime exclusions. Retire the worktree copy after selected historical review and external references are checked.

artifacts.purpose: Historical rationale for the earlier companion deployment setup.
artifacts.schema: Legacy Markdown rationale; current source security and configuration documentation govern setup.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Review of the superseded helper-based deployment assumptions.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Recover historical rationale from private history when a review requires it.

retention_rule.rule: This rationale relies on the retired settings composer. Retire the worktree copy after historical review and external references are checked.

artifacts.purpose: Operator incident timeline and unresolved containment/recovery decisions.
artifacts.schema: DATA.md incident record schema v1: schema_version, incident_id, ts, product_slug, status, summary, recovery_dependencies.
artifacts.producer: Authorized operator following the retained incident-response runbook; no automatic incident writer is shipped.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Incident review, delivery reconciliation and recovery handoff.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore exact private incident records together with referenced state and evidence before resuming affected dispatch.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while incidents, delivery outcomes or recorded recovery dependencies remain unresolved; retire only after explicit reviewed closure.
